candidates.text: The user must manually update the status to “Release for Production” from the FPO List.
Once the status is updated to “Release for Production” and the process is defined, the Auto Job Order creation will proceed accordingly.

PPC Selection:
1. The system will freeze the FPO status at “Release to Factory.”
The user can perform actions on Process, Auto Job Order, and Job Order Search.
2. The user must manually update the status to “Release for Production” from the FPO List.
3. Once the status is updated to “Release for Production” and the process is defined, the Auto Job Order creation will proceed accordingly.

chunks.title: Solution
chunks.heading: Solution
chunks.text:
Under the Auto FPO / Job Order Creation setup, a new column “Trigger Point” will be introduced.
• By default, the value will be MRP/MRL.
• The user will have the option to change it to PPC via a dropdown.
Behaviour Based on Trigger Point Selection:

chunks.title: MRP/MRL (Default Selection)
chunks.heading: Solution › … › MRP/MRL (Default Selection)
chunks.text: • The system will function as per the existing behaviour (no change in current flow).

chunks.title: PPC Selection
chunks.heading: Solution › … › PPC Selection
chunks.text:
• The system will freeze the FPO status at “Release to Factory.”
The user can perform actions on Process, Auto Job Order, and Job Order Search.
• The user must manually update the status to “Release for Production” from the FPO List.
• Once the status is updated to “Release for Production” and the process is defined, the Auto Job Order creation will proceed accordingly.
